target: For ratings, treat a single numeric rating without minimum or “at least” language as exact `[x, x]`; “exactly x” is `[x, x]`, and an explicit “at least x” request is `[x, 5]`.
content_preview: For an explicitly stated approximate hotel nightly budget (for example, “around 750 per night”), pass the stated amount as `budget` without inventing a range. This optional value does not replace miss
